name: GOT-10k (Generic Object Tracking Benchmark)
description: A large-scale visual object tracking benchmark with more than 10,000 video segments spanning diverse object classes and motion patterns. This record contains metadata only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Huang, L., Zhao, X., & Huang, K. (2019). GOT-10k: A Large High-Diversity Benchmark for Generic Object Tracking in the Wild. IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, 43(5), 1562–1577. https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2019.2957464
